This is the behaviour Rich documents for output that isn't a terminal. When `Console` detects it is not writing to a terminal, it strips control codes, so live refreshes print as plain lines. Running the script through `tee` causes this. See the note in [console.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). Setting `force_terminal=True` on the console writes the control codes anyway, if you need them in a file.

Questions like this are best asked in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
